statement: DEVRULES elicitation was waived for the 2026-07-26 heyscottybro session

options.consequence: no ledger of design decisions; house style + UI floors still apply and are mechanically checked

options.choice: run THIN or FULL elicitation first
options.consequence: a real ledger, but 1-7.5h of interrogation before any of the 10 open bugs are touched

rationale: Operator chose house-style-only mode. PATCH (SPEC.md 11) was not runnable: it is defined as supersede-then-propagate over an existing ledger, and heyscottybro had zero records. FULL was declined per HANDOFF 6 (do not force a run to justify the engine) on a mature 227-file app. Recorded so the waiver itself has provenance, per RUN.md 0.5.

statement: Eight bug fixes were implemented before the DEVRULES mode was chosen

options.choice: keep the work and record it
options.consequence: ~600 changed lines exist with no decision records, but the diagnosis is preserved and the paper trail is honest

options.choice: revert and re-derive inside the process
options.consequence: protocol-clean, but discards investigated root causes

choice: keep the work and record it
rationale: Operator chose keep + waiver. The fixes are root-cause diagnoses, not scaffolding: service worker returning index.html for JS chunk requests; bug-screenshots bucket rejecting HEIC and capping at 10MB; Frodo's chat history behind a 1-hour localStorage TTL; agent_actions.tier renamed to agent_id leaving a stale select; expandReminders dropping undated tasks; a duplicate .day-modal mobile rule. Re-deriving them would cost the investigation and buy nothing.

rationale: QF-7 names housestyle-ui.md as the full visual contract with the same force as the QF floors. This is the rulebook the 2026-07-26 UI revamp is measured against.

statement: validate-ui.mjs reports false greens on heyscottybro because the repo is plain CSS, not Tailwind

options.choice: record the blind spot, treat UI-2/3/4/6 as unmeasured
options.consequence: honest baseline; the ramps must be reviewed by hand until the checker understands CSS
a rule claiming a check that does not exist - the exact sin housestyle-ui.md 12 forbids

choice: record the blind spot, treat UI-2/3/4/6 as unmeasured
rationale: validate-ui.mjs is a JSX-aware Tailwind class scanner. heyscottybro styles through index.css and CSS custom properties, so the height, radius, border and focus ramps are invisible to it. Baseline 2026-07-26: UI-1 176 hex literals (real), UI-5 2 repeats (real), UI-7 no globals.css (real), UI-2/3/4/6 unmeasured. Do not add a rule without a check, and do not claim a check that does not exist.

statement: heyscottybro gets a CLAUDE.md inheriting house style (the missing QF-11)

options.consequence: heyscottybro stops being one of the 30-of-32 repos with no rules file

options.choice: wait for QF-11 to be formally added to housestyle.md
options.consequence: the named highest-value gap stays open on this repo

rationale: HANDOFF 5.4 names QF-11 as the floor worth more than any gate in the catalog, and heyscottybro is one of the repos without a CLAUDE.md. The concrete fix for the never-invoked failure mode is a rules file in the repo, so writing one is the whole point of choosing house-style-only mode.

statement: Kiwi Learning's adaptive engine is ported into heyscottybro as a personal-preference model, not as a course tool

options.choice: port the mechanism (BKT belief update + forgetting decay + importance weighting) and apply it to facts about Scott
options.consequence: heyscottybro learns about its user from ordinary use; confidence decays honestly when a belief goes unconfirmed
a second study app inside the planner, duplicating School and Kiwi Learning both

choice: port the mechanism (BKT belief update + forgetting decay + importance weighting) and apply it to facts about Scott
rationale: Operator's ask was that the system learn more about him as he uses it so it can be tailored, not that it become a study app. Kiwi Learning's transferable part is the maths: a belief with a confidence that rises on confirming evidence, falls on contradicting evidence, and decays toward uncertainty when nothing reconfirms it. Applied to context_entries that gives Frodo a profile that is honest about what it actually still knows.

statement: Ported cross-project features declare their origin on the How it works page

future contributors cannot tell what is native and what is mirrored

rationale: Operator asked for it explicitly, and it matches the Atlas precedent (mirror, never move: record the source repo and commit). heyscottybro already carries Kiwi IDE's 50-game arcade with no visible attribution.

choice: FULL elicitation on the new learning subsystem; house-style floor on the existing 227-file app
rationale: Operator reversed the house-style-only choice and asked for the full thing. The learning engine is genuinely new work, which is the shape FULL is for and a real Stage-1 exit candidate. statement: validate-ui.mjs resolves the global stylesheet by the hardcoded basename globals.css, producing a false UI-7 failure and silently skipping UI-4

options.choice: extract the token layer into src/styles/globals.css and report the checker limitation upstream
options.consequence: QF-7 satisfied properly, UI-4 and UI-7 become real checks on this repo, and DEVRULES learns its checker is filename-coupled

options.choice: leave tokens in index.css and mark UI-4/UI-7 unmeasured
options.consequence: a second permanent blind spot alongside DR-004, and a 5223-line stylesheet QF-7 already objects to

choice: extract the token layer into src/styles/globals.css and report the checker limitation upstream
rationale: heyscottybro had three prefers-reduced-motion blocks the whole time; UI-7 was reported failing purely because the file was named index.css. Worse, validate-ui.mjs line 129 only runs the UI-4 border-token loop over files basenamed globals.css, so UI-4 was never checked on this repo and its green was meaningless. Extracting the :root and .admin-shell token scopes into styles/globals.css is what QF-7 asks for independently, so the fix is real rather than a rename to satisfy a grep. Upstream: the checker should resolve the global stylesheet from the entry import graph, not a basename.

statement: UI-5 repeated className strings are resolved by extracting components, not by suppressing the check

options.consequence: two fewer copy-paste sites; the rule does its job
the three-strikes rule stops meaning anything

rationale: Same outcome the Atlas build reported: UI-5 caught three repeated className strings mid-build and extraction was the right answer. Repeats here are a chevron affordance and an expand control, both genuinely reusable.
